ITEM 1 | Pale cream-yellow florets, lightly steamed or roasted, with slightly browned edges, clustered in a loose heap on the upper-left of the plate; florets about 2-3 cm across with some small stems, matte surface | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green curly leaves, finely crinkled and wilted, glossy with a light dressing sheen, piled in a mound about 8 cm across near the center-top; some pale stems visible | 80
ITEM 3 | Fresh flat dark green spinach leaves, mostly whole, slightly wilted, with thin light stems and a few thin orange shreds of carrot scattered through; spread across the upper-right area about 9 cm across | 45
ITEM 4 | Four rectangular browned chunks, each about 4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, reddish-brown with caramelized, slightly crisp exterior and a dense, grainy interior; arranged in a cluster on the lower-left, sitting next to broccoli | 120
ITEM 5 | Bright green broccoli florets, small, with dark green tops and firm stems, about 2-3 cm across, clustered at the lower-center beside the browned chunks | 35
ITEM 6 | Thick wedge of baked dish with a golden-browned top, bubbling-looking melted cheese layer with light brown spots, and a visible red tomato-colored sauce layer beneath; slightly oily sheen, soft and sliceable, occupying the right side of the plate about 10 x 8 cm and roughly 3 cm thick | 230
ITEM 7 | Thin smear of red-orange tomato sauce visible under and along the edge of the baked wedge, glossy and wet-looking | 15
